vulnerabilities.name: OS Command Injection
vulnerabilities.description: The software constructs all or part of an OS command using externally-influenced input directly from an upstream component.

vulnerabilities.name: SQL Injection
vulnerabilities.description: The software constructs all or part of an SQL command using externally-influenced input directly from an upstream component.

vulnerabilities.name: Path Traversal
vulnerabilities.description: The software uses external input to construct a pathname intended to be within a restricted directory, but it does not properly neutralize special elements like '../'.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate input against an allow-list or use os.path.abspath() and verify the base directory.

vulnerabilities.name: Windows SMB Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (EternalBlue)
vulnerabilities.description: A critical remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft's implementation of the SMBv1 protocol. Attackers could exploit it to run arbitrary code on the target system.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Apply security update MS17-010. As an immediate mitigation, disable SMBv1 protocol on all systems.
